text.title: templates Failure Modes
text.summary: 8 antipatterns specific to SDD template use, consolidated from the former `templates` and `templates-planning` pair (CR-006). Each has a description, an observable detector and a concrete repair.

failure-mode.description: `{placeholder}` or `<angle_token>` text survives in a filled artefact, usually in metadata fields such as `**Created:** YYYY-MM-DD` or `Project: {project-name}`.
failure-mode.detector: `grep -nE '\{[a-zA-Z_ ]+\}|<[a-z_0-9]+>|YYYY-MM-DD' <file>` returns any line outside a fenced code block; a heading set differs from the template's.
failure-mode.repair: Run the grep before every commit of a filled artefact; fill or delete each hit; restore the template heading set. Rule r-template-fidelity.

failure-mode.description: Spec, design, plan and tasks are generated in one turn without review gates; design errors compound into every task, and the last files in the turn are silently truncated as the context fills.
failure-mode.detector: Several SDD files share one commit or one agent turn; `implementation-plan.md` links a `design.md` whose Status is still Draft; a later file ends mid-table or mid-sentence.
failure-mode.repair: One artefact per turn, review gate between each, plan only from an Approved design; check the tail of every file written. Rule r-plan-from-approved-design.

failure-mode.description: Task files are generated without reading `design.md`; scopes are mis-sized, architecture decisions are re-made per task, and executor reports do not match the task template because the task file itself deviated.
failure-mode.detector: A task names no AD id; the task's Files table lists paths absent from the design's project structure; the executor's report sections do not match the task file's headings.
failure-mode.repair: Generate tasks from the Approved plan only, each naming its plan row and AD; review every task against the template before execution. Rules r-plan-from-approved-design, r-task-traceability.

failure-mode.description: A scaffold reuses an existing feature number or slug (`feature-024-starter-kits`) and overwrites a reviewed spec with a blank skeleton; nothing in the exit status says so.
failure-mode.detector: `git diff` on `.aidocs/` shows a filled `spec.md` replaced by template text; two features share a number; the scaffold script has no existence check before `mkdir -p`.
failure-mode.repair: Guard the scaffold with an exists check, allocate the number from the highest existing folder plus one, list `.aidocs/` before creating. Rule r-feature-folder-unique.

failure-mode.description: Tasks do not reference implementation-plan rows, plan rows do not reference design decisions, and the FR/AD Coverage table leaves FRs with no task; executor agents lose the context of what decision they are implementing.
failure-mode.detector: An `FR-nnn` in `spec.md` is absent from the coverage table; a task row has an empty AD column; a `task.md` has no plan-row reference.
failure-mode.repair: Complete the coverage table both ways before approval; add plan-row and AD references to every task. Rule r-task-traceability.

failure-mode.description: `Est. Tokens` figures are typed from intuition and run 30 to 50 percent under actuals because they count the edit and forget the reading; a task that loads a 20k-token module before touching it exhausts its budget mid-change.
failure-mode.detector: Estimates are round numbers with no file sizes behind them; the Overview total does not equal the sum of rows; a task that reads existing code has no 20k buffer; execution logs show context exhaustion.
failure-mode.repair: Derive each estimate from file bytes at roughly 4 per token plus a 20k reading buffer; make the total the sum of rows; revise with a version bump after execution. Rule r-token-estimates-with-buffer.

failure-mode.description: The Dependency Graph section is prose, disagrees with the Depends On / Enables columns, or contains a cycle that no agent detected; a parallel executor deadlocks or runs tasks out of order.
failure-mode.detector: The section contains lines that are not `TASK_a -> TASK_b`; an edge appears in the table and not the graph or vice versa; a wave contains a task whose dependency sits in the same or a later wave.
failure-mode.repair: Rewrite the graph as edges equal to the table, run a topological sort, and rebuild the waves from it with a checkpoint after each. Rule r-dependency-graph-acyclic.

failure-mode.description: Roadmap entries are keyed on calendar quarters ("Q3 work") rather than named milestones; on a long-lived project the labels drift and the roadmap is wrong the day the quarter ends without anyone noticing.
failure-mode.detector: Now / Next entries have no milestone name or target month; the Change Log has no rows after the first; the Not Planned table is empty.
failure-mode.repair: Name each milestone, give it a target month and status or confidence, keep Later as undated themes, log every change. Rule r-roadmap-milestones-and-changelog.
